ExtraDock 5.2.1 - Drops, Windows & a Lighter, Steadier Dock! 📂🪟✨

✨ What's New

  • Open windows in the right-click menu: Right-click a running app in the dock to see its open windows and jump straight to the one you want!
  • First click cycles windows: With "Clicking the active app" set to Cycle Windows, the very first click already switches to the app's next window. New docks and ExtraDock 4 imports now use Cycle Windows by default!
  • Free System Trash and File Shelf: The System Trash and File Shelf widgets are now free for everyone!
  • Badges everywhere: The Running Apps widget and the Space Awareness strip now show app badges, just like the dock!

🚀 Improvements

  • Fewer Keychain password prompts: Your license is now stored securely without asking for your Mac password!
  • Up-to-date updater: The built-in updater moves to Sparkle 2.10 with the latest security fixes!
  • Much less disk writing: ExtraDock writes far less to your disk every day, and old caches, history and leftovers now clean themselves up!
  • Faster, steadier window previews: Previews appear faster, no longer jump or resize while you hover, use less memory, and sit on a dark plate so they're easy to read. Blank windows show the app's icon instead of an empty card!
  • Widgets keep their data while the dock hides: Clock, Now Playing, system, network, media, Folder Stack, App Stack and Pro widgets keep their values and icons while an auto-hide dock is hidden, and editing one dock no longer clears widgets on your other docks!
  • Faster widget popovers: Widget popovers and the App Switcher open faster and more smoothly!
  • Smarter Trash widget: The Trash widget only checks with Finder when the Trash actually changed, and asks politely before it needs Finder access!
  • Album covers: Media and Now Playing show Music's own album covers!
  • Matching gauges: CPU, Memory, GPU and Bluetooth Battery rings now match the Battery ring, even on docks with a thin bar!
  • Steady Link and Finder widgets: They no longer grow with cursor magnification!
  • Background Sounds: Every sound plays at the same level and loops without a click!
  • Clear lock messages: A locked widget now says exactly why, for example "Pro required" or "Pro expired"!
  • Faster Export Logs: Diagnostics → Export Logs finishes in seconds and now includes crash reports, so Appit Studio support can help you faster!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Finder drops work again: Dropping files from Finder onto docked folders, apps and the Trash works again (5.2.0 refused them)!
  • Closed apps really hide: With "Show apps with no windows" turned off, apps you closed leave the dock again!
  • Reopened apps come to the front: Clicking an app whose last window you closed (like Mail or Canva) brings its new window to the front instead of leaving it behind other apps!
  • Closed windows come back: Clicking an app in the dock or the App Launcher widget reopens its main window, even while a smaller window of that app is still open (like Outlook)!
  • Floating docks on stacked displays: A floating dock moved to a display arranged above your built-in screen now lands in the right place!
  • Folder Launcher previews refresh: The Stack Preview updates when the folder's contents change!
  • Screenshots widget: It comes back after you resize the dock!
  • TamaDocky: Your pet's stats change while it's on screen, pause while it's away or the screen is locked, and survive a relaunch!
  • Crash fixes: Fixed a crash when apps launch or quit quickly, and a busy dock database is no longer mistaken for a damaged one!
  • Quieter system log: Reserve Dock Space no longer keeps retrying apps that already quit!
  • Exports always finish: Saving diagnostics can no longer freeze the app!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
